name: gen_comisary_sales
script:
# Server Script (API) — gen_comisary_sales
# RestrictedPython-safe: no import. Creates 50 submitted Sales Invoices where
# Comisary sells Finished Chicken to branches (cost center Comisary - JMIT, source warehouse Comisary FG - JMIT).
count = 50
branches = ["Resto-Pasay", "Resto-MOA", "Resto-Pasig"]
items = [
    {"c": "INASAL-PAA", "r": 150.0},
    {"c": "INASAL-PECHO", "r": 180.0},
    {"c": "INASAL-BBQ", "r": 160.0},
]
created = 0
submitted = 0
failed = 0
errors = []
for i in range(count):
    br = branches[i % 3]
    it = items[i % 3]
    day = 1 + (i % 27)
    dstr = "2026-08-" + ("0" + str(day))[-2:]
    qty = 10 + (i % 30)
    rate = it["r"] + ((i % 20) - 10)
    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Sales Invoice",
        "customer": br,
        "posting_date": dstr,
        "due_date": dstr,
        "company": "JMIT",
        "set_posting_time": 1,
        "update_stock": 0,
        "items": [
            {
                "item_code": it["c"],
                "qty": qty,
                "rate": rate,
                "warehouse": "Comisary FG - JMIT",
                "cost_center": "Comisary - JMIT",
            }
        ],
    })
    try:
        doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        created = created + 1
        try:
            doc.submit()
            submitted = submitted + 1
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append("submit " + doc.name + ": " + str(e))
    except Exception as e:
        failed = failed + 1
        errors.append("insert " + str(e))

result = {
    "created": created,
    "submitted": submitted,
    "failed": failed,
    "errors": errors[:5],
}
frappe.response["message"] = result
